description: Fetch image bytes for up to 5 imageDbIds and return them inline as `type: image` content blocks. Falls back to the metadata `imageURL` when the server lacks dedicated image-content delivery or that request fails. No filesystem side-effects.

alias.description: Connection alias. Omit to use alias `default`. An alias registered via brapi_connect works, and so does one the server has a URL configured for (a built-in alias, an operator-configured alias, or `default` on a deployment with a default server), which connects on first use. Calls that used a non-default alias must pass that same alias here.

name: brapi_get_image

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_alias`: No connection is registered under the requested alias, and the server has no base URL configured for it to connect on first use. `auth_token_exchange_failed`: Connecting the alias on first use, the SGN or OAuth token exchange against the BrAPI /token endpoint failed. `auth_no_access_token`: Connecting the alias on first use, the token endpoint answered without returning an access token. `capability_discovery_unavailable`: Neither /serverinfo nor /calls listed any call, and at least one of them timed out, was unreachable, or answered 429 or a 5xx other than 501, so nothing was cached. `upstream_unauthorized`: The BrAPI server answered HTTP 401: it requires credentials, or rejected the ones sent. `upstream_forbidden`: The BrAPI server answered HTTP 403: the credentials sent, or their absence, lack access. `alias_base_url_invalid`: The base URL configured on the server for this alias is not an absolute http(s) URL, or carries credentials. `private_address_blocked`: The base URL configured for this alias, or its token URL, is on a private or reserved address this server may not reach. `images_unsupported`: The BrAPI server does not advertise /images. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

errors.description: Images that could not be loaded, one entry per id.

items.description: Per-image error entry returned when a fetch fails.

error.description: Reason the image could not be loaded.

imageDbId.description: Image identifier the error applies to.

imageHeight.description: Pixel height. Coerced from string when the upstream emits a numeric string.

imageWidth.description: Pixel width. Coerced from string when the upstream emits a numeric string.

observationUnitDbId.description: FK to the observation unit this image depicts.

observationUnitName.description: Display name of the observation unit.

studyDbId.description: FK to the study the image belongs to.

mimeType.description: Content-Type of the byte response, else the metadata mimeType, else application/octet-stream.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the returned byte payload.

warnings.description: Per-image advisories for loaded payloads that appear suspect — e.g. the imageURL fallback returned a non-image MIME type, suggesting the upstream URL is broken.

items.description: Per-image advisory for loaded-but-suspect content (e.g. non-image MIME).

imageDbId.description: Image identifier the warning applies to.

warning.description: Advisory — bytes loaded but something is suspect.

title: Brapi Get Image
